messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate on /v1/embeddings (500s) in eu-west-1. Spike started ~2409876400. Customers affected: 3 orgs. Escalation: P0.

oncall-bot: Alert details: error=INCOMPATIBLE_VARIANT, route=pinned:rl-embed-v2 -> fallback:chat-gen-v1, 95% of fallbacks returning 500.

sahil: seeing this on grafana too. embeddings p50 latency jumped from 40ms -> 1.2s, and 5xx rate 18%.

emma: I'm oncall. confirming impact window, will take lead. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.

jordan: adding context: there was a deployment to variant alias service 30m ago that touched alias mapping tables. Could be a stale swap.

emma: @sahil can you dump the routing policy for the affected customer id=org-324? suspect pinned version mismatch.

sahil: pasted routing policy snapshot:
```yaml
route: "embeddings"
pin: "model:rl-embed-v2@2024-11-12"
fallbacks:
  - variant: "chat-gen-v1"
    reason: "variant-compat-check-failed"
```

lia: that fallback looks wrong — chat-gen-v1 shouldn't be listed as an embedding fallback. something swapped the variant tags.

caroline: do we have a quick mitigation? can we override routing to force fallback to rl-embed-v1 (older) while we investigate?

emma: yes. plan: 1) add emergency override route for org-324 to point to rl-embed-v1 2) unpin the bad alias mapping 3) roll back alias change if needed. executing step 1 now.

jordan: watch out: config push needs prod write perms. @sahil can you run the emergency patch via ops-runbook?

sahil: running: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/override -d '{"org":"org-324","route":"embeddings","model":"rl-embed-v1"}'`

sahil: returned 200. metrics show error rate dropping for org-324 in eu-west-1 within 30s. :thumbsup:

emma: good. applying unpin for alias mapping on global routing table now. i'm in REPL.

emma: found alias swap event: alias "embed-main" was updated by user-deploy-bot at 2409876300 to point to model "chat-gen-v1" due to a bad selector rule.

emma: rolling alias back to previous value: `alias set embed-main rl-embed-v2 --force --reason "emergency rollback"`

eng-runtime-bot: Rollout: alias embed-main reverted to rl-embed-v2 by emma.

lia: double-checking compatibility matrix: rl-embed-v2 -> embeddings OK, chat-gen-v1 -> gen/chat only. compatibility check should have blocked that swap.

caroline: seems like the guard that prevents alias->incompatible-variant swaps failed. is there a failing unit test?

jordan: I see an error in the preflight hook logs: `KeyError: 'compatibility_profile'` during alias-update flow when a specific metadata field is missing. It caused the compatibility check to be skipped.

emma: that explains it. patching now to default to fail-closed if compatibility metadata missing. writing a hotfix.

jordan: small snippet of failing preflight:```py
if model.metadata.get("compatibility_profile") == "embeddings":
    allow = True
# but metadata can be missing -> crash
```

jordan: will change to `if model.metadata.get("compatibility_profile") == "embeddings": ... else: allow=False` and add tests.

caroline: good. how long to deploy hotfix?

emma: staging tests pass. pushing to prod via canary, but will skip canary for alias guard to land immediately due to severity. request approvers: @caroline, @jordan.

caroline: approving emergency hotfix.

eng-runtime-bot: Deploy start: runtime-preflight-fix by jordan, id=deploy-8421.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary complete. Global rollout commencing.

oncall-bot: Update: customer-visible errors reduced by 92% after override+alias rollback. Estimated total affected requests ~12k, errors ~2.1k.

lia: @emma can you confirm whether any customer data was routed to chat-gen-v1? We need to audit request types — embedding calls sent to chat model might have generated nonsense but unlikely to exfiltrate.

emma: quick audit: sample of failed requests show embed-specific payloads (dense arrays) hitting chat-gen-v1 and causing runtime deserializers to throw 500s. No plaintext customer PII seen in logs.

caroline: coordinating customer comms: eng-ops to prepare an incident email: impact window 2409876300-2409876670, degraded embedding quality and 500s for 3 orgs in eu-west-1.

emma: assigning postmortem: eng-runtime to own root cause and fix tests. I will create the postmortem doc and invite runtime+platform.

sahil: creating monitoring alerts to detect alias->incompatible-variant mapping attempts and to alert on compatibility_check failures.

jordan: PR created: fix preflight compatibility guard + unit test. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/1294

emma: timeline for RCA doc: initial draft in 24h, invite ops and product for customer impact notes.

caroline: any follow-ups before closing this thread?

lia: need to run a sweep to find other aliases that may be missing compatibility metadata. I can script that.

emma: assigning tasks: jordan -> merge hotfix, lia -> sweep aliases, sahil -> tighten monitoring, caroline -> customer comms, emma -> postmortem + send initial email.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> degraded -> monitoring. Pager unassigned.

emma: thanks everyone. great response. :heart:

caroline: will post the customer note draft to #incidents-docs for review.

jordan: merged PR and backfilled unit tests.

lia: sweep found 4 aliases with missing metadata; created PR to populate metadata or lock them.

emma: closing thread for now, will reopen if monitoring regresses.

oncall-bot: Thread closed by emma at 2409879999.
